panels.title: Como leer este dashboard
panels.description: Guia para operar tendencias enterprise, top consumidores, forecasts y frescura de evidencia.

options.content: Que muestra: performance, capacidad historica, top consumidores y forecast por host/servicio/dominio. Como interpretarlo: tendencias sostenidas y evidencia expirada elevan riesgo operativo. Accion sugerida: filtrar por lote y resolver primero saturacion, crecimiento y evidencia vencida.

panels.title: Top Consumers Enterprise
panels.description: Hosts con mayor consumo promedio y percentil alto por servicio, dominio y metrica seleccionada.

targets.rawSql: with KpiConLote as (select substring(CapacityKpiId from '^(.+)-Kpi-') as LoadIdCalculado, * from CapacityKpi) select coalesce(r.Name, k.ResourceId) as HostName, c.Environment, c.DomainName, coalesce(s.Name, c.BusinessServiceId) as BusinessService, k.MetricName, k.AverageUtilization, k.P95Utilization, k.PeakUtilization from KpiConLote k left join MonitoredResource r on r.ResourceId = k.ResourceId left join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentName = r.Name and c.LoadId = k.LoadIdCalculado left join Service s on s.ServiceId = c.BusinessServiceId where k.LoadIdCalculado ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and coalesce(c.Environment, 'Unknown') ~ '^(${Environment:regex})' and k.MetricName ~ '^(${MetricName:regex})' order by k.P95Utilization desc, k.PeakUtilization desc limit 20

panels.title: Forecast 30 90 180 365
panels.description: Horizontes de forecast para decisiones de capacidad, filtrables por CPU, RAM, Storage, StorageIO y NetworkIO.

targets.rawSql: with ForecastConLote as (select coalesce(LoadId, substring(ForecastResultId from '^(.+)-Forecast-')) as LoadIdCalculado, * from ForecastResult) select coalesce(r.Name, f.ResourceId) as HostName, c.Environment, f.MetricName, f.Forecast30Days, f.Forecast90Days, f.Forecast180Days, f.Forecast365Days, f.DaysToSaturation from ForecastConLote f left join MonitoredResource r on r.ResourceId = f.ResourceId left join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentName = r.Name and c.LoadId = f.LoadIdCalculado where f.LoadIdCalculado ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and coalesce(c.Environment, 'Unknown') ~ '^(${Environment:regex})' and f.MetricName ~ '^(${MetricName:regex})' order by f.DaysToSaturation asc, f.Forecast90Days desc

panels.title: Frescura de Evidencia
panels.description: Evidencia fresca, vencida, incompleta o faltante por host para evitar conclusiones sin soporte.

targets.rawSql: select c.ComponentName as HostName, c.Environment, e.SourceSystem, e.EvidenceType, e.FreshnessStatus, e.EvidenceState from EnterpriseEvidenceRecord e join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentId = e.ComponentId where e.LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and c.Environment ~ '^(${Environment:regex})' order by e.FreshnessStatus, e.EvidenceState
